parentDecisions.PIA-MUR-D-003c: Stream concept — single PIA blue accent (#2563EB), 3-tab bottom bar, footnote-style citation chips, sheet-heavy navigation, conversation-first default landing

motion.implementation: All durations and easings expressed as CSS custom properties; single token change disables all sheets (e.g., --motion-sheet); prefers-reduced-motion media query sets motion tokens to 0.01ms (preserves layout via keyframe 'to' state)
motion.userSelection: prefers-reduced-motion media query honored by default; .theme-reduce-motion class adds a manual toggle (matches Stream prototype app.js:167-168); the toggle is also accessible via a settings sheet (PIA-MUR-D-002 §6 acknowledgment)
motion.reducedMotionFallback: 0.01ms (not 0ms); preserves keyframe 'to' state on the rendered element so final state is reached via animation rather than skipped

tabBar.tapResponse: instant (no transition; visual press via background flash)

density.implementation: All list rows match final height (no spinners; persistent skeleton); long content scrolls in the sheet panel; row height adapts to Dynamic Type (AX5) by scaling padding, not min-height, to keep touch targets at 44pt
density.userDensityControls: Per PIA-MUR-D-002 §5: text size follows Dynamic Type (system-level); no in-app density toggle in v1; the user can override accent color via .theme-dark and motion via .theme-reduce-motion
density.screenSpecificDensity: Conversations: 19pt body, 14pt caption (default landing, conversation-first); Documents: 19pt body, 14pt caption (matches); Search: 19pt body, 14pt caption (matches); Detail: 19pt body, 14pt caption (matches conversation)
density.rowHeightPolicy: Minimum 44pt (iOS HIG) for any interactive row; AX5 scales body 19pt → 34pt; rows grow vertically as padding scales, min-height is preserved for touch targets

dynamicType.support: All body sizes scale via .theme-ax5 class or system-level Dynamic Type; AX5 (Larger Text accessibility size) supported; ratio 1.78× (19pt → 34pt body)
dynamicType.implementation: Type tokens are CSS custom properties; AX5 multiplier applied at the :root level (.theme-ax5 class); system Dynamic Type on iOS is honored via -apple-system-body/-apple-system-headline (PIA-MUR-D-002 §6)

touchTargets.minimum: 44pt × 44pt (iOS HIG; WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size Minimum Level AA)
touchTargets.tapAreaAudit: Citation chip: 24pt visible glyph + transparent padding to 44pt; tabs: 1/3 width × 49pt height + safe-area; rows: min-height 44pt

colorContrast.target: 7:1 for body text where practical (WCAG 2.2 AAA)

lightModeVerification.accentBodyText: #1D4ED8 on #FFFFFF = 6.1:1 (AAA for < 18pt body text; used for primary buttons with body text)

colorContrast.darkModeVerification: UNVERIFIED per PIA-MUR-D-003c UNVERIFIED items list; requires automated axe-core check at G7 gate (B-6 dependency-approval policy)

accessibleNames.allInteractiveElements: Every button, input, link has an accessible name (text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby)
accessibleNames.iconOnlyButtons: aria-label required (e.g., 'New conversation', 'Upload document', 'Back to conversations', 'Send', 'Workspace: PIA Workspace. Tap to switch.')

liveRegions.thread: role='log' aria-live='polite' aria-relevant='additions' (existing baseline at conversation-detail.ts:40)

landmarks.aside: role='complementary' (e.g., offline banner if persistent; otherwise role='status')

accessibility.headingHierarchy: h1 (page title; visually-hidden) → h2 (section) → h3 (subsection); no skipped levels; citation chip is not a heading

voiceOver.modeDot: aria-hidden='true' (decorative); the mode name is in the row text

keyboard.tabOrder: Top-to-bottom, left-to-right; no tabindex > 0; no positive tabindex anywhere
keyboard.externalKeyboard: Tab / Shift+Tab traverse; Enter / Space activate; Esc closes sheets and modals; focus-visible always shows the outline
keyboard.focusTrap: Sheets and modals trap focus within their panel; Tab cycles, Shift+Tab from first → last, Esc closes

accessibility.skipLink: 'Skip to main content' hidden until focused; first focusable element on every page
accessibility.motionSafety: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce honored in both Safari browser mode and installed PWA mode (UNVERIFIED per PIA-MUR-D-002 §6 for installed PWA; flagged for device-validation)

doNotCache: conversation content (network-required; stale conversation data is unsafe)
document content (network-required; stale document content is unsafe)
any /v1/* response (network-required; API responses are always live)

fetchFailureBehavior.navigation: serve a static offline HTML (minimal shell with network-required splash + retry button)
fetchFailureBehavior.v1Api: let the request fail; the page must handle 401/500 with the error envelope (see dataPolicy.errorEnvelope)

serviceWorker.implementationNote: Service worker implementation is at the implementation-contract phase; this contract specifies behavior, not code

securityHeaders.hsts: Required when served via HTTPS; cloudflared quick-tunnel provides HTTPS automatically (per REPOSITORY_ADAPTER §'Runtime access'/'HTTPS requirement')
securityHeaders.csp: Tighten script-src to allow service-worker registration (per REPOSITORY_BASELINE §3 'CSP observation'); current 'self' 'unsafe-inline' permits SW registration; a stricter policy with nonces is recommended but is an implementation-contract concern
securityHeaders.permissionsPolicy: Keep camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), interest-cohort() (per REPOSITORY_BASELINE §3)

realDataSources: Eval fixtures: evals/answers/datasets/sample.yaml (retention period, AI/weather summary)

errorEnvelope.shape: { error: { code: string, message: string, request_id: string } }
errorEnvelope.userFacing: Show only `code` and a sanitized `message`; NEVER show `request_id` to the user (audit-only)
errorEnvelope.source: Confirmed by HTTP probes (e.g., /v1/me returns this envelope on 401)
errorEnvelope.rationale: request_id is for server-side audit; exposing it leaks correlation IDs to the user

dataPolicy.noMocks: Mock data is not allowed for acceptance evidence; if real data is unavailable (DB down, dev user not provisioned), the workflow blocks and the user is informed (per REPOSITORY_ADAPTER §'Data unavailable behavior')
